hypotheses.exact: Head writes sum to native attention write with relative RMS error <= 1e-5; full Q predicts native finite coefficient changes with relative RMS error <= 1e-4.
hypotheses.intervention_transfer: Rank64 decoder predicts finite head-removal coefficient changes at fidelity >=0.80 in at least three layers.
hypotheses.beats_affine: Rank64 exceeds fitted affine finite-change fidelity by >=0.10 in at least two early/middle layers.

scope: Remove each whole attention-head write at each selected destination, recompute RMSNorm and local MLP, and predict changes in four frozen output coordinates. Upstream state is fixed. This tests local finite response, not downstream behavioral effect or individual source-edge identity.
